Clock: Battle Trial release.script: (function(){const tk=check({type:'game-tick'})||0;const P=storage.dsPend;if(storage.btRel===true||!P||P.e!=='@b'||P.k!==tk-1){skip=true;return;}storage.btH=storage.btHk===tk-1?(storage.btH||0)+1:1;storage.btHk=tk;if(storage.btH<3){skip=true;return;}storage.btRel=true;const Q='Battle Trial: Heroes and Villains';if(check({type:'quest-status',questId:Q,operator:'equals',value:'accepted'})===true)effects.push({type:'quest-complete',questId:Q});log('bt release after '+storage.btH+' held turns');})();
